https://atid.store.core_purpose: The website serves as an e-commerce platform for users to browse, purchase, and manage fashion and lifestyle products online.
business_requirements: Users must be able to browse products by categories, such as clothing, accessories, and other lifestyle items.
Users must be able to view detailed product information, including images, descriptions, prices, and available sizes or variants.
Users must be able to add products to a shopping cart for temporary storage prior to completing a purchase.
Users must be able to securely complete transactions through a checkout process that includes payment and shipping information collection.
Users must be able to create and manage a personal account to view order history, save preferences, and track deliveries.
The system must allow administrators to manage inventory, update product listings, and monitor sales performance.
The platform must provide responsive design for seamless use across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
